title: I`m a writer
author: Aishwariya Laxmi
text:
Sometimes, it means I write.
Sometimes, it means I think.
Sometimes, it means I put a lot of thought
Into everything I think.
I do a lot
But sometimes, it doesn`t show
I do nothing
And then it shows too much
As a writer,
I want to balance how much I show
With how much I do not
So, that`s show and tell
Which you learn over time
And sometimes it doesn`t come out well
But that`s okay, too
A writer`s biggest challenge
Is to remember
Whether it shows or not
`Tells` or not
It is not about the writer`s worth.
stanzas: Sometimes, it means I put a lot of thought
And then it shows too much
I want to balance how much I show
With how much I do not
And sometimes it doesn`t come out well
It is not about the writer`s worth.
